4.3.6 Constraining Input or Output Latency
The input or output latency can, for example, be modeled as sub-chains of the overall
end-to-end chain (segments). The overall end-to-end chain and also the input and
output sub-chains can have attached timing constraints. This way either the overall
end-to-end timing behavior or only the input and output behavior including hardware
delay can be constrained already at VFB-level.
